journal_lines: §a§lDiamond§l. §oSmells like nothing. Shines like everything.§o Took the whole vein.
§aBlue-white glint in the deepslate. Stopped moving. Dug very carefully.
§aSaid nothing when I found it. Worked it out in silence. Diamond.
§aThe deepslate held it tight. Took longer than it should have. Worth it.
§aCold flash in the torchlight. §o§lDiamond§l doesn't glow — it just takes what light there is and keeps it.§o
§aVein ran to four. Then two more beside it. Took all six.
§aPaw flinched when I touched it. §oCold that deep is a different kind of cold.§o Diamond.
§aFound it where no other ore was. §lDiamond§l sits alone down here.
§aThree strikes to open the deepslate. One stone inside. Kept it close on the way home.
§aWorked the seam for an hour. §oThe pick rang different on each one — cleaner, higher.§o All diamond.
§aTwo stones side by side in the rock. §lDiamond§l, both of them.
§aBrought it back. Whole trip was worth it.
